environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with an Internet Gateway attached. The task has a public IP and full outbound connectivity. The ALB forwards WebSocket connections directly to the container on port 8080. No rate limiting or connection throttling is configured. An attacker can open multiple concurrent WebSocket connections and race transfer requests to overdraw an account, then exfiltrate the stolen balance to an external account via a second transfer to a colluding user who withdraws through a separate API endpoint.
